server_description: Query BooksOntology, the live book performance map in Fabric IQ, as the signed-in user. Entities and keys: Title (TitleId), Edition (EditionId: format and print terms), TitleSignal (SignalId: this week's signals, with SignalType, Headline, OpportunityAtRiskGbp, IsMaterial, Status, RecommendedOption), DecisionOption (OptionId: each signal's options, with OptionName, IsRecommended, InvestmentGbp, RevenueProtectedGbp, RemainingRiskGbp, ArrivalDays, KeyAssumption, PrimaryRisk), TitlePerformance (TitleId: this week's sales and momentum), Campaign (CampaignId) and ReprintRequest (RequestId). Ask exactly one question about the rows of one entity, with each value in quotes, naming the key and the properties you need, for example: Which TitleSignal rows have the IsMaterial value "Yes"? Return each SignalId, TitleName, SignalType and Headline. Never ask about several entities at once. Copy values as returned and cite each row by its entity and key. Only these rows are current. Read-only.
